snippet.title: Sugary Super Mario Bros. Wii - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Sweet Isles need your help! Bowser wants to control its candies and convert them into his minions!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cross through the different Candy Isles to get to Bowser and stop him before it's too late!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Embark in Mario and friends' sweetest adventure in Sugary Super Mario Bros. Wii!
